reason: Deep, well-tested Klondike engine and persistence layer, but the app explicitly fails its own release gate (21 hardcoded-color lint violations bypassing the DesignSystem token file), directly violating the single-Theme-token CORE requirement, plus gaps in share sheet, drag gestures, and in-app rules docs.

requirements.text: R-001: Native SwiftUI iOS, 100% local, zero network/accounts/analytics/backend
R-002: All state persists on-device only, no iCloud/CloudKit
R-003: Fully correct single-deck Klondike rules engine
R-004: Tap-to-move via one shared validation/mutation function
R-005: Tap-based relocation of a validly-stacked tableau run as atomic unit
R-006: No illegal move can mutate game state
R-007: True win detection only when all 4 foundations complete
R-008: Explicit stuck-board detection distinct from win, per draw mode
R-009: Full multi-step undo with exact prior-state restoration
R-010: New Game requires confirmation when game unfinished
R-011: Stock/waste/foundation/tableau layout for both draw modes
R-012: Unlimited stock redeal, documented in-app wherever rules/help appears
R-013: Bespoke original card face system, legible at ~45-50pt
R-014: Real card-stock texture, shadow, lighting
R-015: Spring-based deal/flip animation, fresh-deal-only
R-016: Fully art-directed light/dark mode via one shared Theme token file, no literal colors/fonts elsewhere
R-017: One clear original signature visual/interaction hook
R-018: Haptic feedback on move accepted/rejected/win
R-019: Stats screen tracked per draw mode with real empty states
R-020: Best time shows N/A when timer disabled
R-021: Settings with draw-mode confirm, live card-back, timer toggle
R-022: Timer starts on first mutating action, pauses backgrounded
R-023: Local silent game-event recording feeding Stats
R-024: Persisted state settled-only, atomic writes, survives force-quit
R-025: No encryption layer for persistence
R-026: VoiceOver labels, non-color suit differentiation, Reduce Motion fallback
R-027: LaunchScreen themed to card-table background
R-028: Locked portrait-only orientation
R-029: Launches directly into resumed/fresh game, no interstitial screen
R-030: Settings disclosure line that stats are device-local only
R-031: No monetization surface
R-032: No multiplayer/social/Game Center/achievements
R-033: Zero placeholder screens among Game, Stats, Settings
R-034: Win-screen native share sheet with rendered board + solve-time caption
R-035: Live interactive drag gestures (single and multi-card)
DoD-1: Every core feature functionally implemented, not just visual
DoD-2: Primary workflow works end-to-end with real data
DoD-3: App launches to a real screen, not a placeholder
DoD-4: No crash on primary workflow
DoD-5: Every screen has empty/loading/error states
DoD-6: Dark mode styled, both palettes readable
DoD-7: Self-explanatory first screen / onboarding
DoD-8: All views style through DesignSystem tokens, no inline colors/fonts
DoD-9: Every interactive element has accessibilityIdentifier
DoD-10: All declared user flows (flows.json) pass
DoD-11: No TODO/FIXME markers left in source
DoD-12: Settings/preferences screen exists
DoD-13: App icon and display name set
